theory.summary:
**Passive Voice**
Estructura: be + participio pasado. El tiempo lo marca el verbo be.
is/are done · is being done · has been done · was done · was being done · had been done · will be done · will have been done · modal + be done.
Usá "by + agente" solo si aporta información; si es desconocido u obvio, se omite.

**Articles (visto con la pasiva)**
Zero article para la función de la institución: in hospital, in prison, at school, at university.
The para el edificio concreto: She went to the hospital to visit him.
Sin artículo: la mayoría de los países, continentes, lagos (Spain, Lake Geneva). Con the: the USA, the UK, cordilleras, océanos, mares, ríos (the Alps, the Atlantic).

**Causative Have**
have/get + objeto + participio pasado.
1) Otro hace el servicio por vos: I had my car serviced.
2) Algo malo que te pasa: He had his passport stolen.
have es más formal; get es más coloquial.

**Impersonal Passive**
Para noticias y rumores sin decir quién lo afirma (say, believe, think, report, claim, expect, know, allege).
1) It + verbo en pasiva + that + oración: It is reported that the flight was delayed.
2) Sujeto + verbo en pasiva + to-infinitive: He is believed to live in London.
Acción en curso: to be + -ing (is reported to be hiding). Acción anterior: to have + participio (is reported to have fled).

**Identity Theft**
Vocabulario de la lectura: identity theft, computer fraud, security breach, password, scam / scammer, target a victim, access a bank account.

**The Way Up to Heaven (Roald Dahl)**
Mrs Foster tiene un miedo casi patológico a llegar tarde. Mr Foster parece disfrutar retrasándola a propósito.
Al final ella escucha un ruido en el hueco del ascensor (lift shaft), no entra a la casa y se va al aeropuerto.

decks.name: Passive Voice
decks.description: BE + past participle: el tiempo lo marca el verbo BE.

cards.en: The door is locked.
cards.es: La puerta está cerrada con llave.
cards.note: Present simple passive: am/is/are + pp.

cards.en: The burglar was caught.
cards.es: Atraparon al ladrón.
cards.note: Past simple passive: was/were + pp.

cards.en: My house is being painted.
cards.es: Me están pintando la casa.
cards.note: Present continuous passive: am/is/are being + pp.

cards.en: My phone has been stolen.
cards.es: Me robaron el teléfono.
cards.note: Present perfect passive: has/have been + pp.

cards.en: The police station is going to be closed.
cards.es: Van a cerrar la comisaría.
cards.note: Future passive: is going to be / will be + pp.

cards.en: A meeting will be held.
cards.es: Se va a realizar una reunión.
cards.note: 'They'll hold a meeting' en pasiva. will be + pp.

cards.en: She thinks she was being followed.
cards.es: Cree que la estaban siguiendo.
cards.note: Past continuous passive: was/were being + pp.

cards.en: Use the passive when the action matters more than who did it.
cards.es: Usá la pasiva cuando importa más la acción que quién la hizo.
cards.note: Regla de uso de la voz pasiva.

cards.en: The environmental survey was conducted across three remote regions.
cards.es: La encuesta ambiental se hizo en tres regiones remotas.
cards.note: Past simple passive: was/were + pp.

cards.en: Thousands of tons of plastic waste are generated by urban centres every day.
cards.es: Los centros urbanos generan miles de toneladas de plástico por día.
cards.note: Present simple passive + by + agente (aporta información).

cards.en: The delayed passengers were provided with hotel accommodation.
cards.es: A los pasajeros demorados les dieron alojamiento en un hotel.
cards.note: Past simple passive con persona como sujeto: were provided with.

cards.en: All electronic devices must be switched off during take-off.
cards.es: Hay que apagar todos los dispositivos electrónicos durante el despegue.
cards.note: Modal passive: must + be + pp.

cards.en: The system had been compromised before the patch was applied.
cards.es: El sistema había sido vulnerado antes de que se aplicara el parche.
cards.note: Past perfect passive: had been + pp (acción anterior a otra pasada).

cards.en: New evidence is currently being analysed by the forensic team.
cards.es: El equipo forense está analizando nuevas pruebas.
cards.note: Present continuous passive: is/are being + pp.

cards.en: The findings will be published in an international journal.
cards.es: Los hallazgos se van a publicar en una revista internacional.
cards.note: Future passive: will be + pp.

cards.en: A lot of money has been raised for the local charity.
cards.es: Se juntó mucha plata para la organización benéfica local.
cards.note: Present perfect passive: has/have been + pp.

cards.en: Flights can be affected by sudden turbulence.
cards.es: Los vuelos pueden verse afectados por turbulencias repentinas.
cards.note: Modal passive: can + be + pp.

cards.en: The contract should have been checked by a lawyer before signing.
cards.es: El contrato debería haber sido revisado por un abogado antes de firmarlo.
cards.note: Past modal passive: should + have been + pp.

cards.en: The confidential data was deleted before the computer was sold.
cards.es: Borraron los datos confidenciales antes de vender la computadora.
cards.note: Dos pasivas en past simple: was deleted / was sold.

cards.en: The flight had to be diverted due to bad weather.
cards.es: Tuvieron que desviar el vuelo por el mal tiempo.
cards.note: Obligación pasada en pasiva: had to + be + pp.

cards.en: My uncle is recovering in hospital.
cards.es: Mi tío se está recuperando en el hospital (internado).
cards.note: Zero article: in hospital = como paciente (la función de la institución).

cards.en: His lawyer went to the hospital to get the medical records.
cards.es: Su abogado fue al hospital a buscar la historia clínica.
cards.note: The hospital = el edificio, no va como paciente.

cards.en: Lake Geneva is in Switzerland, near the Alps.
cards.es: El lago de Ginebra está en Suiza, cerca de los Alpes.
cards.note: Sin artículo: países y lagos. Con the: cordilleras (the Alps), océanos, ríos.

decks.name: Causative Have
decks.description: have + object + past participle: otro lo hace por vos, o algo malo te pasa.

cards.en: I had my hair cut.
cards.es: Me corté el pelo (me lo cortaron).
cards.note: Otro lo hace por vos. Compará: 'I cut my hair' = vos mismo.

cards.en: We had our photo taken.
cards.es: Nos sacaron una foto.
cards.note: have + object + pp. Alguien nos la sacó.

cards.en: You should have your eyes tested.
cards.es: Deberías hacerte revisar la vista.
cards.note: Un profesional lo hace por vos.

cards.en: Our neighbours are having a swimming pool built.
cards.es: A los vecinos les están construyendo una pileta.
cards.note: Causative en continuo: are having + object + pp.

cards.en: She had her iPhone stolen.
cards.es: Le robaron el iPhone.
cards.note: Algo malo que te sucede. have + object + pp.

cards.en: I had my bank account hacked.
cards.es: Me hackearon la cuenta bancaria.
cards.note: Algo malo que te pasa, sin aclarar quién.

cards.en: We had our house burgled.
cards.es: Nos entraron a robar a la casa.
cards.note: Algo malo: have + object + pp.

cards.en: Have you ever had your bag snatched?
cards.es: ¿Alguna vez te arrebataron la cartera?
cards.note: Pregunta con causative para algo malo.

cards.en: We need to have our documents translated by a professional.
cards.es: Tenemos que hacer traducir los documentos por un profesional.
cards.note: need to have + objeto + pp: servicio que encargás.

cards.en: She had her house painted before selling it.
cards.es: Hizo pintar la casa antes de venderla.
cards.note: had + objeto + pp: otro lo hizo por ella.

cards.en: I got my eyes tested by an optician yesterday.
cards.es: Ayer me hice revisar la vista con un óptico.
cards.note: get + objeto + pp: más coloquial que have.

cards.en: They had their luggage searched at customs.
cards.es: Les revisaron el equipaje en la aduana.
cards.note: had + objeto + pp: lo hizo otra persona.

cards.en: The homeowner had the damaged roof repaired immediately.
cards.es: El dueño hizo reparar el techo dañado enseguida.
cards.note: had + objeto + pp: servicio contratado.

cards.en: The company is having a new security system installed this week.
cards.es: La empresa está haciendo instalar un sistema de seguridad nuevo esta semana.
cards.note: Present continuous causative: is having + objeto + pp.

cards.en: He got his wallet stolen at the crowded station.
cards.es: Le robaron la billetera en la estación llena de gente.
cards.note: get + objeto + pp: algo malo que te pasa.

cards.en: The author had her paper proofread before publication.
cards.es: La autora hizo corregir su artículo antes de publicarlo.
cards.note: had + objeto + pp: otro lo revisó.

cards.en: We will have the venue decorated a day before the conference.
cards.es: Vamos a hacer decorar el salón un día antes de la conferencia.
cards.note: Future causative: will have + objeto + pp.

cards.en: I had my car repaired at the garage yesterday.
cards.es: Ayer me arreglaron el auto en el taller.
cards.note: had + objeto + pp: no lo arreglaste vos.

decks.name: Impersonal Passive
decks.description: It is said that… / He is believed to be… para noticias, sin asumir la afirmación.

cards.en: It is said that he is dangerous.
cards.es: Se dice que es peligroso.
cards.note: It is + pp + that… No decís quién lo afirma.

cards.en: It is believed that he is a local man.
cards.es: Se cree que es un hombre de la zona.
cards.note: It is believed that + oración.

cards.en: It is thought that the mayor will resign.
cards.es: Se piensa que el intendente va a renunciar.
cards.note: Verbos: say, believe, think, report, know, expect.

cards.en: The man is said to be in his forties.
cards.es: Se dice que el hombre tiene unos cuarenta y pico.
cards.note: Subject + passive verb + to-infinitive.

cards.en: The burglar is believed to be a local man.
cards.es: Se cree que el ladrón es de la zona.
cards.note: is believed to be: más impersonal.

cards.en: He is believed to have left the country.
cards.es: Se cree que se fue del país.
cards.note: Acción anterior: to have + pp.

cards.en: The robbers are thought to have entered through a window.
cards.es: Se piensa que los ladrones entraron por una ventana.
cards.note: are thought to have + pp.

cards.en: He is reported to be very polite.
cards.es: Se informa que es muy educado.
cards.note: Del listening 'Britain's most polite armed robber'.

cards.en: It is believed that the new policy will reduce emissions.
cards.es: Se cree que la nueva política va a reducir las emisiones.
cards.note: It + is believed + that + oración.

cards.en: The missing lighthouse keepers are thought to have been swept away by a wave.
cards.es: Se piensa que una ola arrastró a los fareros desaparecidos.
cards.note: to have been + pp: acción anterior y en pasiva.

cards.en: It was reported that several cyberattacks were launched.
cards.es: Se informó que se lanzaron varios ciberataques.
cards.note: It + was reported + that: reporte en pasado.

cards.en: The company is known to be planning a major expansion.
cards.es: Se sabe que la empresa está planeando una gran expansión.
cards.note: to be + -ing: acción en curso.

cards.en: It is said that regular sleep improves memory.
cards.es: Se dice que dormir con horarios regulares mejora la memoria.
cards.note: It + is said + that + oración.

cards.en: The ancient object is claimed to have belonged to a royal family.
cards.es: Se afirma que el objeto antiguo perteneció a una familia real.
cards.note: to have + pp: acción anterior al reporte.

cards.en: It was expected that the treaty would be signed.
cards.es: Se esperaba que firmaran el tratado.
cards.note: It + was expected + that: expectativa en pasado.

cards.en: The suspect is alleged to have committed identity fraud.
cards.es: Se alega que el sospechoso cometió fraude de identidad.
cards.note: is alleged + to have + pp: delito anterior.

cards.en: It has been confirmed that the CEO will step down.
cards.es: Se confirmó que el director ejecutivo va a renunciar.
cards.note: It + has been confirmed + that.

cards.en: Extreme weather is considered to be getting worse.
cards.es: Se considera que el clima extremo está empeorando.
cards.note: to be + -ing: proceso en curso.

cards.en: The suspect is believed to have fled the country.
cards.es: Se cree que el sospechoso huyó del país.
cards.note: Acción anterior al reporte: to have + pp.

decks.name: Identity Theft
decks.description: Vocabulario clave de la lectura sobre robo de identidad.

cards.en: identity theft
cards.es: robo de identidad
cards.note: Usar los datos de otro para hacerse pasar por esa persona.

cards.en: dating site
cards.es: sitio de citas
cards.note: Donde Constance encontró fotos usadas sin permiso.

cards.en: personal information
cards.es: información personal
cards.note: Datos que no hay que compartir online.

cards.en: to misuse someone's photos
cards.es: usar indebidamente las fotos de alguien
cards.note: misuse = uso indebido / mal uso.

cards.en: to steal someone's identity
cards.es: robar la identidad de alguien
cards.note: steal + object. Lo que le pasó a Martin Peterson.

cards.en: fake profile
cards.es: perfil falso
cards.note: Perfil creado con datos robados.

cards.en: privacy
cards.es: privacidad
cards.note: Lo que se pierde con el robo de identidad.

cards.en: Thousands of internet users fall victim to computer fraud every year.
cards.es: Miles de usuarios caen víctimas de fraude informático cada año.
cards.note: computer fraud = fraude informático; fall victim to = caer víctima de.

cards.en: Never share your online banking password with anyone.
cards.es: Nunca compartas la contraseña del home banking con nadie.
cards.note: password = contraseña.

cards.en: The security breach affected millions of accounts.
cards.es: La brecha de seguridad afectó a millones de cuentas.
cards.note: security breach = brecha / filtración de seguridad.

cards.en: Scammers create fake websites to trick victims.
cards.es: Los estafadores crean sitios web falsos para engañar a las víctimas.
cards.note: scammer = estafador; scam = estafa.

cards.en: He discovered he was a victim of identity theft.
cards.es: Descubrió que era víctima de robo de identidad.
cards.note: victim of identity theft.

cards.en: Strong password policies are essential for businesses.
cards.es: Las políticas de contraseñas seguras son esenciales para las empresas.
cards.note: strong password = contraseña segura.

cards.en: Cybercriminals try to bypass two-factor authentication.
cards.es: Los ciberdelincuentes intentan saltear la verificación en dos pasos.
cards.note: cybercriminal = ciberdelincuente.

cards.en: Her personal data was leaked online after a server attack.
cards.es: Filtraron sus datos personales en internet después de un ataque a los servidores.
cards.note: to leak data = filtrar datos.

cards.en: The police are working to track down online scammers.
cards.es: La policía trabaja para rastrear a los estafadores en línea.
cards.note: track down = rastrear, ubicar.

decks.name: The Way Up to Heaven
decks.description: Vocabulario y expresiones clave del cuento de Roald Dahl.

cards.en: delayed flight
cards.es: vuelo demorado
cards.note: El vuelo de Mrs Foster a París se demora.

cards.en: fog
cards.es: niebla
cards.note: La niebla retrasa el vuelo y la hace volver a casa.

cards.en: to be afraid of being late
cards.es: tener miedo de llegar tarde
cards.note: El miedo extremo de Mrs Foster.

cards.en: to delay someone on purpose
cards.es: demorar a alguien a propósito
cards.note: Lo que hace Mr Foster para manipularla.

cards.en: the little white box
cards.es: la cajita blanca
cards.note: La excusa de Mr Foster para volver a entrar a la casa.

cards.en: to hear sounds inside the house
cards.es: escuchar ruidos dentro de la casa
cards.note: Ella los oye y decide no entrar.

cards.en: to feel safe and free
cards.es: sentirse segura y libre
cards.note: Cómo se siente ella finalmente en París.

cards.en: Mrs Foster had an almost pathological fear of being late.
cards.es: Mrs Foster tenía un miedo casi patológico a llegar tarde.
cards.note: fear of being late: el rasgo central del personaje.

cards.en: Her husband seemed to take a malicious pleasure in delaying her.
cards.es: Su marido parecía disfrutar con maldad de retrasarla.
cards.note: take pleasure in + -ing.

cards.en: The atmosphere in the house was heavy with tension.
cards.es: El ambiente en la casa estaba cargado de tensión.
cards.note: heavy with tension = cargado de tensión.

cards.en: As the clock ticked away, her heart began to beat wildly.
cards.es: Mientras pasaba el tiempo, el corazón le empezó a latir con fuerza.
cards.note: tick away = pasar el tiempo (el reloj).

cards.en: A strange sound came from the lift shaft inside the empty house.
cards.es: Un sonido extraño salía del hueco del ascensor dentro de la casa vacía.
cards.note: lift shaft = hueco del ascensor.

cards.en: She listened intently at the front door.
cards.es: Escuchó con atención en la puerta de entrada.
cards.note: listen intently = escuchar con mucha atención.

cards.en: Mr Foster secretly torments his anxious wife.
cards.es: Mr Foster atormenta en secreto a su esposa ansiosa.
cards.note: torment = atormentar.

cards.en: She had a terrible fear of being late and her husband knew it.
cards.es: Ella tenía un miedo terrible a llegar tarde y su marido lo sabía.
cards.note: be afraid / have a fear of being late.

cards.en: The story ends with a cold, calculated revenge.
cards.es: La historia termina con una venganza fría y calculada.
cards.note: calculated revenge = venganza calculada.

quizzes.name: Quiz: Passive Voice
quizzes.description: Practica voz pasiva en diferentes tiempos

questions.prompt: Completa en presente simple pasivo: 'The door _______ locked.'
questions.explanation: Present simple passive con 'is' (singular). The door = sujeto singular.

questions.prompt: Transforma a voz pasiva sin cambiar el tiempo: 'Somebody has stolen my phone.'
questions.explanation: Present perfect passive (acción reciente sin especificar cuándo). 'has been stolen' = me lo robaron (recientemente).

questions.prompt: Completa: 'La casa fue pintada el año pasado.' → 'The house _______ painted last year.'
questions.explanation: Past simple passive con 'was' (singular). The house = sujeto singular.

questions.prompt: ¿Cuál es la forma correcta en futuro pasivo?
options: The project is going to built.
questions.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + past participle.

questions.prompt: Complete: 'Me están pintando la casa.' → 'My house _______ being painted.'
questions.explanation: Present continuous passive: is/are + being + pp. 'My house' = singular → 'is'.

questions.prompt: Completa en pasiva (carry out): 'The emergency evacuation ____ by the crew as soon as the flight landed.'
questions.explanation: Past simple passive: acción terminada en un momento del pasado (as soon as the flight landed).

questions.prompt: Completa en pasiva (develop): 'At this very moment, new energy solutions ____ by engineers.'
questions.explanation: Present continuous passive: proceso en curso ahora (at this very moment).

questions.prompt: Completa en pasiva negativa (not find): 'The missing flight logs ____ when the investigator searched the room.'
questions.explanation: Past simple passive negativo: were not + pp.

questions.prompt: Completa en pasiva (cut): 'Hundreds of jobs ____ if the company decides to downsize next month.'
questions.explanation: Future passive: will be + pp (resultado futuro de un primer condicional).

questions.prompt: Completa en pasiva (inform): 'All applicants ____ of their results by tomorrow evening.'
questions.explanation: Future perfect passive (will have been + pp) para algo terminado antes de un límite futuro (by tomorrow evening).

questions.prompt: Elige la opción correcta: 'The old lighthouse on the island ____ for over half a century.'
questions.explanation: Present perfect passive con for: desde el pasado hasta hoy.

questions.prompt: Elige la opción correcta: 'Passengers were annoyed because their luggage ____ to the wrong destination.'
questions.explanation: Past perfect passive: el envío pasó antes de que se enojaran.

questions.prompt: Elige la opción correcta: 'Extra assistance must ____ to passengers with small children.'
questions.explanation: Después de un modal, la pasiva es be + pp.

questions.prompt: Elige la opción correcta: 'While the case ____ by the police, new witnesses came forward.'
questions.explanation: Past continuous passive: proceso en curso cuando pasó otra cosa.

questions.prompt: Artículos: 'My uncle is recovering ____ hospital, whereas his lawyer went to ____ hospital to get the records.'
questions.explanation: in hospital = como paciente (zero article); the hospital = el edificio.

questions.prompt: ¿Cuál es la traducción correcta de 'I had my hair cut.'?
options: Me corté el pelo (me lo cortaron).
Yo mismo me corté el pelo.
Le corté el pelo a otra persona.
Dejé que me creciera el pelo.
questions.correct: Me corté el pelo (me lo cortaron).
questions.explanation: I had my hair cut. = Me corté el pelo (me lo cortaron).. Contexto: Otro lo hace por vos. Compará: 'I cut my hair' = vos mismo.

questions.prompt: Completa el causativo: 'We had our photo ____.'
questions.explanation: have + objeto + participio: We had our photo taken.

questions.prompt: ¿Qué significa 'You should have your eyes tested.'?
options: Deberías revisarle la vista a otra persona.
No deberías hacerte revisar la vista.
questions.explanation: Un profesional lo hace por vos.

questions.prompt: Completa el participio de build: 'Our neighbours are having a swimming pool ____.'
questions.explanation: have + objeto + participio; build → built.

questions.prompt: ¿Qué significa 'She had her iPhone stolen.'?
questions.explanation: have + objeto + participio también describe algo malo que le sucede a alguien.

questions.prompt: Completa con el participio (renew): 'I need to have my passport ____ before I travel to London.'
questions.explanation: need to have + objeto + participio: servicio que tenés que encargar.

questions.prompt: Completa con el participio (check): 'The manager has the annual report ____ by the auditor twice a year.'
questions.explanation: Present simple causativo para algo habitual: has + objeto + pp.

questions.prompt: Completa: 'During the heatwave, they had an air conditioning unit ____ in their office.'
questions.explanation: had + objeto + participio pasado.

questions.prompt: Completa con el participio (steal): 'Watch out! You might get your phone ____ if you leave it on the table.'
questions.explanation: get + objeto + pp para algo malo que te pasa.

questions.prompt: Completa con el verbo causativo en pasado: 'She ____ her hair cut by a famous stylist last Saturday.'
questions.explanation: had (o got) + objeto + pp: se lo cortó otra persona.

questions.prompt: Elige la opción correcta: 'We are planning to ____ the entire house renovated before winter.'
questions.explanation: have + objeto + pp: encargar la reforma.

questions.prompt: Elige la opción correcta: 'He didn't build the fence himself; he ____ by a local contractor.'
questions.explanation: No lo hizo él: had + it + built.

questions.prompt: Elige la opción correcta: 'They ____ their car serviced yesterday because the engine was making a noise.'
questions.explanation: Pasado (yesterday): had + objeto + pp.

questions.prompt: Elige la opción correcta: 'How often do you ____ your teeth checked by the dentist?'
questions.explanation: Pregunta en presente: do you have + objeto + pp.

questions.prompt: Traduce con have + objeto + participio: 'A la periodista le robaron la cámara.'
questions.correct: The journalist had her camera stolen
questions.explanation: Algo malo que le pasa: had + her camera + stolen.
variations: The journalist had her camera stolen
The journalist got her camera stolen

questions.prompt: Traduce con have + objeto + participio: 'Vamos a hacer instalar paneles solares el mes que viene.'
questions.correct: We will have solar panels installed next month
questions.explanation: Causativo en futuro: will have + objeto + pp.
variations: We will have solar panels installed next month
We'll have solar panels installed next month
We will get solar panels installed next month
We'll get solar panels installed next month
We're going to have solar panels installed next month
We are going to have solar panels installed next month

questions.prompt: ¿Cuál es la traducción correcta de 'It is said that he is dangerous.'?
options: Se sabe que está en peligro.
questions.explanation: It is said that he is dangerous. = Se dice que es peligroso.. Contexto: It is + pp + that… No decís quién lo afirma.

questions.prompt: Completa la pasiva impersonal: 'It is ____ that he is a local man.'
questions.explanation: It is believed that + oración: se cree que...

questions.prompt: ¿Qué significa 'It is thought that the mayor will resign.'?
options: Se piensa que el intendente va a renunciar.
El intendente piensa que otros van a renunciar.
Se sabe que el intendente ya renunció.
Se piensa que el intendente no va a renunciar.
questions.correct: Se piensa que el intendente va a renunciar.
questions.explanation: Verbos: say, believe, think, report, know, expect.

questions.prompt: Completa la pasiva impersonal con el participio de say: 'The man is ____ to be in his forties.'
questions.explanation: Subject + is said + to-infinitive.

questions.prompt: ¿Qué oración presenta una creencia general sin identificar quién la sostiene?
options: The burglar is believed to be a local man.
The burglar told a local man.
questions.correct: The burglar is believed to be a local man.
questions.explanation: Subject + is believed + to-infinitive presenta una creencia sin nombrar su fuente.

questions.prompt: Transforma: 'People expect that the new terminal will open next month.' → 'It ____ that the new terminal will open next month.'
questions.explanation: It + verbo en pasiva (presente) + that.

questions.prompt: Transforma: 'Journalists report that the suspect escaped last night.' → 'The suspect ____ to have escaped last night.'
questions.explanation: Sujeto + is reported + to have + pp (la fuga es anterior al reporte).

questions.prompt: Transforma: 'Experts know that lack of sleep affects memory.' → 'Lack of sleep ____ to affect memory.'
questions.explanation: Sujeto + is known + to-infinitive para un hecho general.

questions.prompt: Transforma: 'Historians believe that the document was written in the 15th century.' → 'The document ____ to have been written in the 15th century.'
questions.explanation: Sujeto + is believed + to have been + pp (acción anterior y en pasiva).

questions.prompt: Transforma: 'They claim that the company hid safety information.' → 'It ____ that the company hid safety information.'
questions.explanation: It + is claimed + that + oración.

questions.prompt: Elige la opción correcta: 'The market ____ to recover steadily over the next quarter.'
questions.explanation: Sujeto + is expected + to-infinitive (acción futura).

questions.prompt: Elige la opción correcta: 'It ____ that ocean currents are changing faster than predicted.'
questions.explanation: It + is reported + that + oración.

questions.prompt: Elige la opción correcta: 'The former minister ____ to have accepted illegal payments.'
questions.explanation: Sujeto + is believed + to have + pp.

questions.prompt: Elige la opción correcta: 'The fugitive is reported ____ in a mountain cabin at this very moment.'
questions.explanation: Acción en curso ahora: to be + -ing.

questions.prompt: Elige la opción correcta: 'The manuscript ____ to have been lost during the war, but it was found in a library.'
questions.explanation: Creencia del pasado que después resultó falsa: was thought.

questions.prompt: Traduce empezando por 'The author': 'Se dice que la autora está escribiendo una novela nueva.'
questions.correct: The author is said to be writing a new novel
questions.explanation: Acción en curso: is said + to be + -ing.
variations: The author is said to be writing a new novel
It is said that the author is writing a new novel

quizzes.name: Quiz: The Way Up to Heaven
quizzes.description: Practica the way up to heaven

questions.prompt: ¿Cuál es la traducción correcta de 'delayed flight'?
questions.explanation: delayed flight = vuelo demorado. Contexto: El vuelo de Mrs Foster a París se demora.

questions.prompt: ¿Qué significa 'to be afraid of being late'?
questions.explanation: El miedo extremo de Mrs Foster.

questions.prompt: Completa la expresión que significa a propósito: 'to delay someone on ____'.
questions.explanation: on purpose = a propósito.

questions.prompt: En The Way Up to Heaven, ¿para qué usa Mr Foster la excusa de la cajita blanca?
options: Para volver a entrar a la casa y retrasar la salida.
Para explicar la cancelación del vuelo.
Para pedirle a su hija que viaje.
Para justificar un cambio de aeropuerto.
questions.correct: Para volver a entrar a la casa y retrasar la salida.
questions.explanation: Mr Foster dice haber perdido la cajita; Mrs Foster la encuentra en el auto.

questions.prompt: Completa el verbo: 'Mr Foster appeared to ____ his wife deliberately by looking for things at the last minute.'
questions.explanation: delay = retrasar (también vale torment = atormentar).

questions.prompt: Completa: 'She heard a faint noise coming from the lift ____.'
questions.explanation: lift shaft = hueco del ascensor.

questions.prompt: Completa: 'Mrs Foster suffered from an almost pathological fear of being ____ for a train or plane.'
questions.explanation: Su obsesión es llegar tarde.

questions.prompt: Elige la opción correcta: 'Mr Foster seemed to take a malicious ____ in delaying their departures.'
questions.explanation: take pleasure in + -ing = disfrutar de hacer algo.

questions.prompt: ¿Por qué sufría tanto Mrs Foster al principio del cuento?
options: She suffered from an intense fear of being late.
She did not want to visit her family in Paris.
Her husband forced her to live in a small flat.
questions.correct: She suffered from an intense fear of being late.
questions.explanation: El miedo a llegar tarde es el motor de la historia.

questions.prompt: Elige la opción correcta: 'While Mr Foster was inside the house, Mrs Foster ____ at the front door.'
questions.explanation: Escucha el ruido en el hueco del ascensor y decide no entrar.

questions.prompt: Escribe en inglés: 'vuelo demorado'.
questions.explanation: delayed = demorado.

questions.prompt: Escribe en inglés: 'tener miedo de llegar tarde' (con to be afraid).
questions.correct: to be afraid of being late
questions.explanation: afraid of + -ing.
variations: to be afraid of being late

questions.prompt: ¿Qué escucha Mrs Foster cuando vuelve a la puerta de la casa?
options: A faint noise from the lift shaft
questions.correct: A faint noise from the lift shaft
questions.explanation: El ruido viene del ascensor trabado, y ella se va igual.
